extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral scientists applying to the NIGMS NIH Pathway to Independence (K99/R00) award
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting an NIGMS K99/R00 (Pathway to Independence) application, including eligibility limits, budget/effort caps for K99 and R00 phases, transition/activation rules, and review/funding priorities. Intended to help postdocs determine fit, prepare documentation, and understand review/administration expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must be in mentored postdoctoral training at time of application
rubrics_metrics.description: "Individuals must be in mentored, postdoctoral training positions to be eligible to apply to the K99/R00 program."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an applicant achieves independence (any faculty or non-mentored research position) before a K99 award is made, neither the K99 nor the R00 will be awarded. Applicants should ensure they are in a mentored postdoctoral position when applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Four-year limit on postdoctoral research experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have no more than 4 years of postdoctoral research experience at the time of the initial or resubmission application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count only time dedicated to research activities. Applicants nearing the end of the four-year eligibility must make a strong case for the need for additional mentored training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible terminal degrees
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible principal investigators include promising postdoctoral candidates who have terminal clinical or research doctorates (e.g., Ph.D., M.D., D.O., Pharm.D., D.C., N.D., D.D.S., D.V.M., Sc.D., D.N.S., or equivalent).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your degree is equivalent to the listed terminal clinical or research doctorates if not explicitly named.

rubrics_metrics.name: No faculty appointments or equivalent allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: NIGMS will not use K99/R00 awards to support individuals who already have faculty appointments — including assistant professor, clinical assistant professor, research assistant professor and instructor — or their equivalent in academia, industry or elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you hold any faculty-equivalent appointment before the award is made, you are ineligible for K99/R00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cannot have concurrent or duplicative career awards or certain PHS awards
rubrics_metrics.description: A candidate may not simultaneously submit or have an application pending for any other NIH career award (e.g., K01, K07, K08, K22, K23, K25) or any PHS award that duplicates provisions of the Pathway to Independence Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not apply to or hold overlapping NIH career development awards or PHS awards duplicating K99/R00 provisions while applying for or receiving the K99/R00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligibility based on prior PI/lead roles or large non-PHS awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Ineligible individuals include current and former principal investigators on NIH research project grants, comparable individual career development awards, or equivalent non-PHS peer-reviewed research grants over $100,000 direct costs per year, or project leaders on subprojects of program project (P01) or center (P50) grants or similar awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have been PI on significant awards or led subprojects of large multi-component grants, you are generally ineligible. Check specifics if unsure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions and extensions to the 4-year eligibility window
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH may approve certain extensions to the 4-year limit (e.g., one-year childbirth extension) and will consider other well-justified circumstances on a case-by-case basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Childbirth: NIH will approve a one-year extension for childbirth; applicants must provide the child's date of birth in the extension request justification and submit it to IC program officials/scientific contacts at least 12 weeks before application. Other parental, medical, military, or well-justified leave generally under 12 months is typically not included in the 4-year limit. Part-time postdoctoral research is pro-rated. Clinical training with no research involvement is not counted. For unusual circumstances (e.g., significant field change), contact NIGMS staff at least 8 weeks before submission and include a cover letter explaining the special circumstances and indicating NIH approval where applicable. Refer to NIH Extension Policy for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation on timing of application (apply by third year)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply no later than the third year of their postdoctoral training to ensure awardees receive maximum benefit from the K99 phase and to make a timely transition to independence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applying earlier maximizes the usefulness of the mentored phase. Awardees must complete at least 1 full year of mentored training under the K99 before transitioning to the R00.

rubrics_metrics.name: K99 intent and justification requirement near eligibility end
rubrics_metrics.description: The K99 is not intended to extend time in the postdoctoral lab for individuals already competitively prepared for an independent faculty position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individuals nearing the end of their four-year eligibility must make a strong case for the need for additional mentored training; reviewers will consider whether the mentored phase is truly needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentored Phase (K99) budget and effort limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Total cost per year for the mentored phase may not exceed $125,000. Salary limited to $75,000 plus applicable fringe benefits and up to $25,000 for research support costs for a 12-month budget period. Candidates must commit a minimum of 75% of full-time professional effort (9 calendar months) during the mentored phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare budgets consistent with these caps and document the 75% effort commitment clearly in the application and institutional assurances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent Phase (R00) budget and effort limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Total cost for the independent investigator phase may not exceed $249,000 per year (includes direct costs and F&A). For NIGMS, equipment is limited to $50,000 in the R00 phase. Grantees are required to commit 75% of their total effort to establish their research program during the R00 phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget planning for the R00 should reflect the total cost cap and equipment limit; the institution must support and allow the required effort commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: R00 activation/transition conditions and procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Transition to the R00 is contingent on scientific and career development progress and receiving and accepting an offer of a tenure-track or equivalent position; activation is not automatic and requires NIGMS prior approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not accept a faculty offer without first consulting the NIGMS program officer. Once the offer meets requirements, the PI can accept and will receive approval to submit the R00 application. The new extramural institution must submit the R00 using PHS 398; the R00 application is noncompeting and must include a letter from the department/division chair describing the institution's commitment and plans to establish the candidate's research program. The R00 may be submitted a couple of months after starting the new position. The transition is intended to be continuous but may occur any time after the first year of K99 or within one year after completing K99. NIGMS program and grant administrative staff will review the R00 application for completeness and responsiveness prior to approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement that proposed research aligns with participating IC missions
rubrics_metrics.description: The K99/R00 Award is limited to postdoctoral trainees who propose research relevant to the mission of one or more of the participating NIH institutes and centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are strongly encouraged to read the NOFO and email nigmsk99@nigms.nih.gov to confirm mission fit and eligibility before applying. NIGMS gives high priority to applications directly related to the missions of its divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and funding decision considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: In making funding decisions, NIGMS will give high priority to mission fit and consider the significance of the research, technical merit, and the applicant's training and career development potential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications are evaluated on both the research project aims and the career development objectives; both elements are considered in review. Emphasize significance, rigorous approach, and a clear career development plan in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative and preparatory actions encouraged before applying
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are strongly encouraged to read the NOFO, consult the NIH Pathway to Independence Award materials and FAQs, and contact NIGMS K99 staff (nigmsk99@nigms.nih.gov) to discuss potential applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early contact can clarify mission fit, eligibility, and program expectations; in some cases, alternative options may be identified. For extensions to eligibility, contact staff at least 8 weeks before submission; for childbirth extension provide DOB at least 12 weeks before submission.
